summary.en: Clean and split text, join and format reports, and solve palindrome, anagram and word-count problems.
summary.bn: লেখা পরিষ্কার করো, শব্দ ভাগ ও জোড়া লাগাও, রিপোর্ট সাজাও এবং প্যালিনড্রোম, অ্যানাগ্রাম ও শব্দ গোনার সমস্যা সমাধান করো।

notes: split, join, strip, replace, find, casefold and the f-string formats shown work on Python 3.10–3.12. Unicode data may evolve, so the practice tasks specify ASCII where exact character categories matter.

sections.title: Turn text into values you can compare
Clean boundaries, separate fields and join results
Clean input and inspect the normalized form
Choose a display rule and a comparison rule
State what text means before processing it

examples.title: Clean a course list
examples.explanationHtml: split uses commas as boundaries and strip trims each resulting field. join puts a separator between fields. replace changes only the first requested occurrence here. find returns position 10 for MAT and -1 for missing EEE.

examples.title: Format a small price report
examples.explanationHtml: The fields align text left and numbers right. The total has two fractional digits, attendance becomes 87.5%, and the integer reference uses leading zeros. Width sets a minimum, so long values are not cut off.

examples.title: Check a normalized palindrome
examples.explanationHtml: The generator inside join supplies one retained character at a time without building an extra list. casefold ignores letter case, and isalnum removes spaces and punctuation. The normalized word sequence reads the same backwards.

examples.title: Compare anagram letters
examples.explanationHtml: Sorting retains repeated letters while ignoring their original order. The normalized phrases match. aab and abb do not match because an anagram needs equal multiplicities, not merely equal sets of letters.

examples.title: Count whitespace-separated words
examples.explanationHtml: Calling split without a separator collapses whitespace runs and drops outer whitespace. The newline is another boundary. Both lab and notes occur twice after case folding, giving four total words.

practice.title: Normalize spacing
practice.statementHtml: Read one line of text. Replace each run of whitespace with one space and remove leading or trailing whitespace. Print the cleaned line; all-whitespace input becomes a blank line.
hints: split with no argument finds words, and a space separator joins them.

practice.title: ASCII palindrome
practice.statementHtml: Read one line containing ASCII characters. Ignore case and all characters except letters a–z and digits 0–9. Print YES if the normalized text is a palindrome, otherwise NO. Treat an empty normalized string as a palindrome.
hints: Build the normalized string before reversing it.

practice.title: ASCII anagram
practice.statementHtml: Read two lines containing English letters and spaces. Ignore spaces and letter case. Print YES if their letter counts match, otherwise NO. Blank lines are allowed.
hints: Sorting letters preserves duplicate counts, while a set would lose them.

practice.title: Comma field cleanup
practice.statementHtml: Read a comma-separated line of course codes. Strip outer whitespace from each field, discard empty fields and print the remaining codes joined by a semicolon. A line with no codes prints a blank line.
hints: split with a comma preserves empty fields, so filter them after cleaning.

practice.title: Most frequent word
practice.statementHtml: Read one line of lowercase English words. Print the most frequent word and its count separated by a space. Break ties alphabetically. A blank line prints EMPTY.
hints: Visit sorted keys and update the winner only for a strictly larger count.

quiz.prompt: How do whitespace splitting and explicit-space splitting differ?
quiz.explanation: Default splitting groups whitespace and removes empty ends; an explicit separator preserves empty fields.
quiz.code:
print(" a  b ".split())
print(" a  b ".split(" "))

quiz.prompt: What does find return when the substring starts at zero or is absent?
quiz.explanation: find returns a zero-based position and uses -1 for absence.

quiz.prompt: Which characters does strip remove from both ends?
quiz.explanation: The argument is a set of removable characters, not an exact prefix or suffix.

quiz.prompt: Why is if text.find("lab") an incorrect presence test?
options: Python forbids find in a condition
Position zero is false, while absent -1 is true
quiz.explanation: Compare with -1 explicitly or use "lab" in text.

quiz.prompt: Which expression joins codes with a comma between them?
quiz.explanation: join is a separator string method; each supplied item must be a string.

quiz.prompt: What does .2f request inside an f-string?
options: A float with exactly two significant digits
Fixed-point display with two digits after the decimal point
An integer padded to two positions
quiz.explanation: Formatting chooses display precision and does not change the stored float.

quiz.prompt: Why is set(first) == set(second) insufficient for anagrams?
options: It ignores how many times each character occurs
quiz.explanation: aab and abb have the same unique letters but different multiplicities.

quiz.prompt: What does an empty normalized palindrome comparison return?
quiz.explanation: The empty string equals its reverse; a problem can define another policy if needed.

quiz.prompt: What does a minimum field width do with longer text?
options: It wraps to a new line
quiz.explanation: Width pads short values but does not limit long values.

quiz.prompt: Which operation ignores repeated whitespace boundaries?
quiz.explanation: Default splitting recognizes runs of whitespace, including tabs and newlines.

quiz.prompt: Why must a text algorithm state its normalization policy?
options: Case, punctuation and Unicode choices can change the answer
quiz.explanation: Define which characters count and whether case matters before comparing text.

keyPoints.en: Default split groups whitespace, while explicit separators retain empty fields.
keyPoints.bn: সাধারণ split একসঙ্গে থাকা ফাঁকা অংশকে এক সীমা ধরে; নির্দিষ্ট সেপারেটরে খালি ফিল্ড থাকে।

keyPoints.en: join puts a chosen separator between string items.
keyPoints.bn: join স্ট্রিংগুলোর মাঝখানে বেছে নেওয়া সেপারেটর বসায়।

keyPoints.en: find returns -1 for absence, so test its result explicitly.
keyPoints.bn: খুঁজে না পেলে find -1 দেয়, তাই ফল স্পষ্টভাবে যাচাই করো।

keyPoints.en: Formatting controls display rather than stored numeric accuracy.
keyPoints.bn: ফরম্যাটিং দেখানোর ধরন ঠিক করে; সংখ্যার সংরক্ষিত নির্ভুলতা বদলায় না।

keyPoints.en: Anagrams require equal character counts, not only equal character sets.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যানাগ্রামে অক্ষরের সেট মেলার পাশাপাশি প্রতিটি অক্ষরের সংখ্যাও মিলতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Define cleaning rules before checking palindromes or counting words.
keyPoints.bn: প্যালিনড্রোম পরীক্ষা বা শব্দ গোনার আগে লেখা পরিষ্কারের নিয়ম ঠিক করো।

examQuestions.question: Contrast split() with split(",") for empty fields and whitespace.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Default split groups whitespace and omits empty boundary fields. Explicit comma splitting preserves empty fields between adjacent separators and at the ends. Spaces inside those fields remain until stripped.

examQuestions.question: Explain why bool("lab".find("lab")) is False and bool("lab".find("x")) is True.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The successful match starts at index zero, whose truth value is false. Absence is represented by -1, a nonzero integer whose truth value is true. Use membership or compare the position with -1.

examQuestions.question: Check whether a word is an anagram of another word, ignoring case but preserving repeated letters.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
first = "Listen"
second = "Silent"
print(sorted(first.casefold()) == sorted(second.casefold()))

The result is True. Sorting preserves every letter occurrence, unlike set conversion.
